info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Support Tickets Create-v3-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Creation API enables users to effectively initiate new support requests within the system. This endpoint allows for the submission of detailed ticket information, facilitating swift communication between users and support teams. Typical consumers of this API include customer service platforms and internal tools that automate support workflows. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their customer support processes and improve issue resolution times.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new support ticket, providing necessary details like title, description, and priority level. Upon successful creation, a confirmation response will be returned along with the ticket ID.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating a new ticket. This should include all necessary details related to the ticket being created, such as the title, description, priority level, and any relevant metadata.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the request.

customer.description: Information about the customer making the request.

resource.description: The resource associated with the ticket.

priority.description: The priority level of the request, where higher numbers indicate higher priority.

amount.description: The monetary amount associated with the request.

currency.description: The currency of the amount specified.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether a notification is required for this request.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the request was made.

recordIndex.description: The index of the record in a collection.
